item.nusmp.great_jura_travelling_cloak.c: Normal Grade. A grey-green travelling cloak of the kind sold in the markets at the edge of the Great Jura Forest. It sheds rain and keeps the road dust off the neck.
item.nusmp.great_jura_travelling_cloak.d: A grey-green travelling cloak of the kind sold in the markets at the edge of the Great Jura Forest. It sheds rain and keeps the road dust off the neck.
item.nusmp.little_slime_charm.card: Normal Grade. A palm-sized blue slime in a knotted cord that wobbles when it is happy. It mends a scratch if it is pressed gently.
item.nusmp.little_slime_charm.desc: A palm-sized blue slime in a knotted cord that wobbles when it is happy. It mends a scratch if it is pressed gently.
item.nusmp.goblin_village_hide_vest.card: Normal Grade. A vest of stitched boar hide from the goblin village, patched many times and cut generously. It stops a bite and does not stop a conversation.
item.nusmp.goblin_village_hide_vest.desc: A vest of stitched boar hide from the goblin village, patched many times and cut generously. It stops a bite and does not stop a conversation.
item.nusmp.kobold_miners_lamp.card: Normal Grade. A tin lamp with a thick glass bead that the kobolds of the Dwargon mines hang from the belt. Its light is small and very steady.
item.nusmp.kobold_miners_lamp.desc: A tin lamp with a thick glass bead that the kobolds of the Dwargon mines hang from the belt. Its light is small and very steady.
item.nusmp.dwargon_smiths_leather_cap.ca: Normal Grade. A scorched leather cap worn by the apprentices of the Dwargon forges. It has saved more eyebrows than helmets have saved heads.
item.nusmp.dwargon_smiths_leather_cap.de: A scorched leather cap worn by the apprentices of the Dwargon forges. It has saved more eyebrows than helmets have saved heads.
item.nusmp.novice_magic_knights_cap.card: Normal Grade. A navy cap with a small clover stitched on it, handed to every new recruit of a Magic Knights squad. It is a little big, to be grown into.
item.nusmp.novice_magic_knights_cap.desc: A navy cap with a small clover stitched on it, handed to every new recruit of a Magic Knights squad. It is a little big, to be grown into.
item.nusmp.four_leaf_squires_pin.card: Normal Grade. A brass pin in the shape of a four-leaf clover, pinned to the coats of squires who have not yet got a squad. The luck is very small, and it is real.
item.nusmp.four_leaf_squires_pin.desc: A brass pin in the shape of a four-leaf clover, pinned to the coats of squires who have not yet got a squad. The luck is very small, and it is real.
item.nusmp.hage_village_work_boots.card: Normal Grade. Thick work boots from a poor village at the end of the kingdom, resoled so often that the soles are a different leather from the uppers. They are good for running with a heavy load.
item.nusmp.hage_village_work_boots.desc: Thick work boots from a poor village at the end of the kingdom, resoled so often that the soles are a different leather from the uppers. They are good for running with a heavy load.
item.nusmp.bandaged_training_wraps.card: Normal Grade. Strips of linen wound from knuckle to elbow by someone who has been told to do three hundred more swings. They hold the wrist steady.
item.nusmp.bandaged_training_wraps.desc: Strips of linen wound from knuckle to elbow by someone who has been told to do three hundred more swings. They hold the wrist steady.
item.nusmp.caravan_water_flask.card: Normal Grade. A leather-wrapped flask from a desert caravan, always a little cool. A mouthful drives the dust out of the throat and the tiredness out of the legs.
item.nusmp.caravan_water_flask.desc: A leather-wrapped flask from a desert caravan, always a little cool. A mouthful drives the dust out of the throat and the tiredness out of the legs.
item.nusmp.street_thiefs_sash.card: Normal Grade. A bright red sash from the markets of Balbadd, worn by boys who are faster than the guards. It shows where the wearer was last seen, and not where they are.
item.nusmp.street_thiefs_sash.desc: A bright red sash from the markets of Balbadd, worn by boys who are faster than the guards. It shows where the wearer was last seen, and not where they are.
item.nusmp.sindria_traders_scarf.card: Normal Grade. A light scarf of the sea-trade, woven with a small blue knot for safe voyages. It keeps the sun off the neck and the water off the mind.
item.nusmp.sindria_traders_scarf.desc: A light scarf of the sea-trade, woven with a small blue knot for safe voyages. It keeps the sun off the neck and the water off the mind.
item.nusmp.supporters_rucksack.card: Normal Grade. A deep canvas rucksack for the porter who walks behind the adventurers in Orario and carries everything they will not. It is built for a long day on the stairs.
item.nusmp.supporters_rucksack.desc: A deep canvas rucksack for the porter who walks behind the adventurers in Orario and carries everything they will not. It is built for a long day on the stairs.
item.nusmp.familia_emblem_pin.card: Normal Grade. A small enamel pin of a Familia's emblem, given with a first blessing. It reminds the wearer who is waiting at home.
item.nusmp.familia_emblem_pin.desc: A small enamel pin of a Familia's emblem, given with a first blessing. It reminds the wearer who is waiting at home.
item.nusmp.babel_street_sandals.card: Normal Grade. Light sandals for the stairs of the upper floors, lashed to the ankle with thin cord. They are quiet on stone.
item.nusmp.babel_street_sandals.desc: Light sandals for the stairs of the upper floors, lashed to the ankle with thin cord. They are quiet on stone.
item.nusmp.guild_mark_armband.card: Normal Grade. A red cloth band with the guild's stamp pressed in it, worn above the bracer by members who like to be seen. Friends find the wearer quickly in a crowd.
item.nusmp.guild_mark_armband.desc: A red cloth band with the guild's stamp pressed in it, worn above the bracer by members who like to be seen. Friends find the wearer quickly in a crowd.
item.nusmp.happys_fish_charm.card: Normal Grade. A charm of a dried blue fish, left behind by a flying cat who valued it above gold. It gives its owner a spring in the step.
item.nusmp.happys_fish_charm.desc: A charm of a dried blue fish, left behind by a flying cat who valued it above gold. It gives its owner a spring in the step.
item.nusmp.melromarc_guards_coif.card: Normal Grade. A chain coif of the city guard of Melromarc, with a nasal bar. Its mail is thin and its stitching is honest.
item.nusmp.melromarc_guards_coif.desc: A chain coif of the city guard of Melromarc, with a nasal bar. Its mail is thin and its stitching is honest.
item.nusmp.filo_feather_charm.card: Normal Grade. A pale feather kept in a leather loop, shed by a very large bird who likes to run. Its owner finds a gap in the stride when it is needed.
item.nusmp.filo_feather_charm.desc: A pale feather kept in a leather loop, shed by a very large bird who likes to run. Its owner finds a gap in the stride when it is needed.
item.nusmp.medicine_peddlers_satchel.car: Normal Grade. A satchel of dried herbs and little bottles, hung on the belt of a peddler who knows every weed in the kingdom. The best of them is always on top.
item.nusmp.medicine_peddlers_satchel.des: A satchel of dried herbs and little bottles, hung on the belt of a peddler who knows every weed in the kingdom. The best of them is always on top.
item.nusmp.ring_of_minor_protection.card: Normal Grade. A plain iron ring set with a chip of blue glass, enchanted by a hedge wizard on a slow Tuesday. It turns the odd blow away.
item.nusmp.ring_of_minor_protection.desc: A plain iron ring set with a chip of blue glass, enchanted by a hedge wizard on a slow Tuesday. It turns the odd blow away.
item.nusmp.adventurers_hooded_cloak.card: Normal Grade. A grey wool cloak with a deep hood, the first thing in most adventurers' packs and the last thing they would give up. It keeps off the weather and the eyes.
item.nusmp.adventurers_hooded_cloak.desc: A grey wool cloak with a deep hood, the first thing in most adventurers' packs and the last thing they would give up. It keeps off the weather and the eyes.
item.nusmp.studded_leather_jerkin.card: Normal Grade. A jerkin of boiled leather with iron studs, the standard answer to the question of what a rogue should wear. It rattles a little less than mail.
item.nusmp.studded_leather_jerkin.desc: A jerkin of boiled leather with iron studs, the standard answer to the question of what a rogue should wear. It rattles a little less than mail.
item.nusmp.everburning_torch_charm.card: Normal Grade. A little tin torch that never goes out and never gets hot, worn on a cord by those who dislike the dark. Struck against a wall it throws a spark.
item.nusmp.everburning_torch_charm.desc: A little tin torch that never goes out and never gets hot, worn on a cord by those who dislike the dark. Struck against a wall it throws a spark.
item.nusmp.e_rank_hunters_work_gloves.ca: Normal Grade. Padded gloves from the Hunters Association's supply counter, issued to rank E raiders who will not be asked to do anything difficult. They hold a blade well.
item.nusmp.e_rank_hunters_work_gloves.de: Padded gloves from the Hunters Association's supply counter, issued to rank E raiders who will not be asked to do anything difficult. They hold a blade well.
item.nusmp.gate_scavengers_satchel.card: Normal Grade. A dark satchel for the odds and ends a scavenger can lift from a gate before it closes. A last bit of loot always seems to fit.
item.nusmp.gate_scavengers_satchel.desc: A dark satchel for the odds and ends a scavenger can lift from a gate before it closes. A last bit of loot always seems to fit.
item.nusmp.association_rubber_boots.card: Normal Grade. Black boots with a hard toe, standard issue for the clean-up teams who walk in after the raid. They do not slip on anything.
item.nusmp.association_rubber_boots.desc: Black boots with a hard toe, standard issue for the clean-up teams who walk in after the raid. They do not slip on anything.
item.nusmp.mansion_servants_apron.card: Normal Grade. A white and navy apron from a certain mansion in the countryside, starched against any stain. It is a surprisingly good thing to be wearing when a sword comes at you.
item.nusmp.mansion_servants_apron.desc: A white and navy apron from a certain mansion in the countryside, starched against any stain. It is a surprisingly good thing to be wearing when a sword comes at you.
item.nusmp.beatrices_doll_charm.card: Normal Grade. A small ringleted doll on a ribbon with a very serious face. It is not a spirit, and it still sits up when something dark comes near.
item.nusmp.beatrices_doll_charm.desc: A small ringleted doll on a ribbon with a very serious face. It is not a spirit, and it still sits up when something dark comes near.
item.nusmp.axel_adventurers_scarf.card: Normal Grade. A long red scarf from a town where the adventurers are broke and proud of it. It has been used as a bandage, a towel and a flag.
item.nusmp.axel_adventurers_scarf.desc: A long red scarf from a town where the adventurers are broke and proud of it. It has been used as a bandage, a towel and a flag.
item.nusmp.nazarick_pages_sash.card: Normal Grade. A violet and gold sash of the lowest servants of a very large tomb. They are told that being noticed is worse than being useful.
item.nusmp.nazarick_pages_sash.desc: A violet and gold sash of the lowest servants of a very large tomb. They are told that being noticed is worse than being useful.
item.nusmp.starter_town_leather_tunic.ca: Normal Grade. The tunic every player starts with, plain brown and a bit too clean. It is a reminder to be careful on the first floor.
item.nusmp.starter_town_leather_tunic.de: The tunic every player starts with, plain brown and a bit too clean. It is a reminder to be careful on the first floor.
Normal Grade. A black and white jacket from a research facility at the end of the world, issued to every Master in training. It carries a small charm against curses.
A black and white jacket from a research facility at the end of the world, issued to every Master in training. It carries a small charm against curses.
item.nusmp.leaf_genin_forehead_protector: Normal Grade. A blue cloth band with a small steel plate engraved with a village's leaf, worn by every fresh graduate. It is a good thing to bump into a wall with.
A blue cloth band with a small steel plate engraved with a village's leaf, worn by every fresh graduate. It is a good thing to bump into a wall with.
item.nusmp.alchemists_chalk_pouch.card: Normal Grade. A pouch of chalk and a bit of charcoal, for the scribbling of circles on a floor. A circle takes a moment, and the ground helps for a moment.
item.nusmp.alchemists_chalk_pouch.desc: A pouch of chalk and a bit of charcoal, for the scribbling of circles on a floor. A circle takes a moment, and the ground helps for a moment.
item.nusmp.east_blue_sailors_bandana.car: Normal Grade. A red and white bandana of the sort tied by sailors, thieves and one particular boy. It keeps the sweat out of the eyes in a fight.
item.nusmp.east_blue_sailors_bandana.des: A red and white bandana of the sort tied by sailors, thieves and one particular boy. It keeps the sweat out of the eyes in a fight.
item.nusmp.hunter_exam_number_plate.card: Normal Grade. A numbered badge pinned to the chest of an applicant during the exam. Its owner is much more calm when the number is low.
item.nusmp.hunter_exam_number_plate.desc: A numbered badge pinned to the chest of an applicant during the exam. Its owner is much more calm when the number is low.
Normal Grade. Heavy cuffs sewn with lead, worn through a hard month of exercise and removed with a sigh. The arms come back stronger than they went in.
Heavy cuffs sewn with lead, worn through a hard month of exercise and removed with a sigh. The arms come back stronger than they went in.
item.nusmp.academy_students_black_robe.c: Normal Grade. A black robe with a white collar, cut for students of a spirit academy who are told it will fit in time. It does not hinder a swing.
item.nusmp.academy_students_black_robe.d: A black robe with a white collar, cut for students of a spirit academy who are told it will fit in time. It does not hinder a swing.
item.nusmp.elf_village_herb_pouch.card: Normal Grade. A mossy pouch of dried leaves that every elf village keeps by the door. A pinch in the tea clears a head.
item.nusmp.elf_village_herb_pouch.desc: A mossy pouch of dried leaves that every elf village keeps by the door. A pinch in the tea clears a head.
item.nusmp.dungeon_cooks_apron.card: Normal Grade. A stained canvas apron with deep pockets and a number of burns. It is the most comfortable armour in a dungeon.
item.nusmp.dungeon_cooks_apron.desc: A stained canvas apron with deep pockets and a number of burns. It is the most comfortable armour in a dungeon.
item.nusmp.duelists_deck_box_belt.card: Normal Grade. A belt with a hard case for a deck of forty cards. A top card is always drawn a bit sooner.
item.nusmp.duelists_deck_box_belt.desc: A belt with a hard case for a deck of forty cards. A top card is always drawn a bit sooner.
item.nusmp.wanderers_waystone.card: Normal Grade. A smooth river stone on a cord, picked up on a long walk and kept ever since. Rubbing it shows the way ahead more clearly.
item.nusmp.wanderers_waystone.desc: A smooth river stone on a cord, picked up on a long walk and kept ever since. Rubbing it shows the way ahead more clearly.
item.nusmp.pilgrims_walking_boots.card: Normal Grade. Resoled boots for a long pilgrimage, with the dust of three kingdoms ground into them. They go on from the very first step.
item.nusmp.pilgrims_walking_boots.desc: Resoled boots for a long pilgrimage, with the dust of three kingdoms ground into them. They go on from the very first step.
item.nusmp.rope_climbers_gloves.card: Normal Grade. Thick gloves with a rubbed palm, favoured by climbers and sailors. The wearer can reach a little further when it matters.
item.nusmp.rope_climbers_gloves.desc: Thick gloves with a rubbed palm, favoured by climbers and sailors. The wearer can reach a little further when it matters.
item.nusmp.squad_vice_captains_circlet.c: Special Grade. A thin silver circlet with a red stone, lent by a squad to the one who keeps the rest in line. The mana runs smoother through it.
item.nusmp.squad_vice_captains_circlet.d: A thin silver circlet with a red stone, lent by a squad to the one who keeps the rest in line. The mana runs smoother through it.
Special Grade. A steel helm with a red plume from the neighbouring kingdom's knights, tough enough to take the first blow of a lance.
A steel helm with a red plume from the neighbouring kingdom's knights, tough enough to take the first blow of a lance.
item.nusmp.s_class_trial_hood.card: Special Grade. A hood worn by the guild's candidates to the S-Class trial on a far island. It is lined with tough thread and an old nerve.
item.nusmp.s_class_trial_hood.desc: A hood worn by the guild's candidates to the S-Class trial on a far island. It is lined with tough thread and an old nerve.
item.nusmp.elven_chain_shirt.card: Special Grade. A shirt of fine linked rings made by the elves of a grey forest, light as cloth and almost as quiet. It is worn under a plain tunic by those who would rather not be seen to need it.
item.nusmp.elven_chain_shirt.desc: A shirt of fine linked rings made by the elves of a grey forest, light as cloth and almost as quiet. It is worn under a plain tunic by those who would rather not be seen to need it.
item.nusmp.golden_dawn_recruits_coat.car: Special Grade. A gold and white coat of a famous squad, for a recruit who has done something worth noticing. It is cut for freedom of movement and pride.
item.nusmp.golden_dawn_recruits_coat.des: A gold and white coat of a famous squad, for a recruit who has done something worth noticing. It is cut for freedom of movement and pride.
item.nusmp.tortoise_shell_cuirass.card: Special Grade. A cuirass of a spirit tortoise's shell, sanded and fitted by a smith in the eastern fields. It is heavy and it does not crack.
item.nusmp.tortoise_shell_cuirass.desc: A cuirass of a spirit tortoise's shell, sanded and fitted by a smith in the eastern fields. It is heavy and it does not crack.
item.nusmp.beastkin_hunters_boots.card: Special Grade. Soft-soled boots of the beastkin hunters, made for the long chase through the forest. They know the ground by the feel of it.
item.nusmp.beastkin_hunters_boots.desc: Soft-soled boots of the beastkin hunters, made for the long chase through the forest. They know the ground by the feel of it.
item.nusmp.kingdom_couriers_boots.card: Special Grade. Blue boots of the royal couriers who carry the sealed word from city to city. A good courier never stops for water.
item.nusmp.kingdom_couriers_boots.desc: Blue boots of the royal couriers who carry the sealed word from city to city. A good courier never stops for water.
item.nusmp.boots_of_the_winding_path.car: Special Grade. Soft boots of a ranger of the green road, that turn the way ahead into a short corner. A bramble is not an obstacle to them.
item.nusmp.boots_of_the_winding_path.des: Soft boots of a ranger of the green road, that turn the way ahead into a short corner. A bramble is not an obstacle to them.
item.nusmp.silver_guild_pendant.card: Special Grade. A silver pendant of a mage guild's second rank, struck with the guild's mark and the owner's name. It keeps the owner's magic in order.
item.nusmp.silver_guild_pendant.desc: A silver pendant of a mage guild's second rank, struck with the guild's mark and the owner's name. It keeps the owner's magic in order.
item.nusmp.familia_falna_locket.card: Special Grade. A gold locket holding a lock of a goddess's hair and a crumb of the blessing she gave. It beats a little faster in a fight.
item.nusmp.familia_falna_locket.desc: A gold locket holding a lock of a goddess's hair and a crumb of the blessing she gave. It beats a little faster in a fight.
item.nusmp.desert_dancers_veil_cape.card: Special Grade. A thin veil-cape from the dancers of the desert palaces, cut so that it will not catch on a blade. It billows when the wearer turns, and the blade is not where it was.
item.nusmp.desert_dancers_veil_cape.desc: A thin veil-cape from the dancers of the desert palaces, cut so that it will not catch on a blade. It billows when the wearer turns, and the blade is not where it was.
item.nusmp.d_rank_raiders_mantle.card: Special Grade. A heavy mantle for raiders who have cleared enough low gates to be trusted with a middle one. It has the faint smell of dungeon dust.
item.nusmp.d_rank_raiders_mantle.desc: A heavy mantle for raiders who have cleared enough low gates to be trusted with a middle one. It has the faint smell of dungeon dust.
item.nusmp.adventurers_mana_flask_belt.c: Special Grade. A belt with five loops of small glass flasks for the explosion-minded. A sip of the right one puts a bit of power back.
item.nusmp.adventurers_mana_flask_belt.d: A belt with five loops of small glass flasks for the explosion-minded. A sip of the right one puts a bit of power back.
item.nusmp.guild_veterans_sash.card: Special Grade. A faded sash worn by mercenaries of the northern guild who have survived ten contracts. Its colour is not what it was, and neither is its owner's.
item.nusmp.guild_veterans_sash.desc: A faded sash worn by mercenaries of the northern guild who have survived ten contracts. Its colour is not what it was, and neither is its owner's.
item.nusmp.gate_raider_grip_gloves.card: Special Grade. Gloves with a slip-proof palm, worn by raiders who climb out of gates by the skin of their teeth. They hold their grip when the rest of the body will not.
item.nusmp.gate_raider_grip_gloves.desc: Gloves with a slip-proof palm, worn by raiders who climb out of gates by the skin of their teeth. They hold their grip when the rest of the body will not.
item.nusmp.mana_skin_wrap.card: Special Grade. A violet wrap drawn through a loop of mana and shaped into a thin skin on the forearm. It is a first step toward the mana skin of a real knight.
item.nusmp.mana_skin_wrap.desc: A violet wrap drawn through a loop of mana and shaped into a thin skin on the forearm. It is a first step toward the mana skin of a real knight.
item.nusmp.dragon_slayer_apprentice_brac: Special Grade. Scarred bracers of those who study the old lost magic from a guild elder who never finishes a lesson. They feel warm and a bit dangerous.
Scarred bracers of those who study the old lost magic from a guild elder who never finishes a lesson. They feel warm and a bit dangerous.
item.nusmp.spirit_whisper_bell.card: Special Grade. A little glass bell that rings only when a spirit is near. It is a sweet note, and the owner is more at ease for hearing it.
item.nusmp.spirit_whisper_bell.desc: A little glass bell that rings only when a spirit is near. It is a sweet note, and the owner is more at ease for hearing it.
item.nusmp.compass_of_true_north.card: Special Grade. A brass compass that points always north, and never tells a lie about it. In a maze it is worth ten lanterns.
item.nusmp.compass_of_true_north.desc: A brass compass that points always north, and never tells a lie about it. In a maze it is worth ten lanterns.
item.nusmp.hi_potion_vial_bandolier.card: Special Grade. A bandolier of green vials sold at the Guild stalls for a lot more than they should. The top one never seems to run dry.
item.nusmp.hi_potion_vial_bandolier.desc: A bandolier of green vials sold at the Guild stalls for a lot more than they should. The top one never seems to run dry.
item.nusmp.quiet_mages_flower_locket.car: Special Grade. A locket of a quiet mage's habit, holding a faded flower that is never replaced. It dulls the edge of a strange spell.
item.nusmp.quiet_mages_flower_locket.des: A locket of a quiet mage's habit, holding a faded flower that is never replaced. It dulls the edge of a strange spell.
item.nusmp.apprentices_training_sword.de: A blunt-edged practice sword handed to every recruit of a Magic Knights squad before the squad lets them near a real fight. It is plain, and it is well balanced. Use: Practice Cut.
item.nusmp.apprentices_training_sword.ca:
Normal Grade longsword (25 damage, 1.6 attacks a second).
Practice Cut (use; cooldown 25 s, 1% magicules): You swing the way you were taught, and it is almost clean.
Tensura engravings: sturdy.
item.nusmp.gate_scavengers_knife.desc: A cheap black knife issued to the clean-up crews of the Hunters Association, sharp enough to cut a pouch from a dead monster and not much else. Use: Quick Stab.
item.nusmp.gate_scavengers_knife.card:
Normal Grade dagger (20 damage, 2.2 attacks a second).
Quick Stab (use; cooldown 20 s, 1% magicules): You jab fast, before the thing can turn.
Tensura engravings: swift.
item.nusmp.adventurers_handaxe.desc: A one-handed axe that chops firewood in the evening and orcs in the morning. It is thrown only by those who mean to pick it up again. Use: Throw Axe.
item.nusmp.adventurers_handaxe.card:
Normal Grade handaxe (24 damage, 1.4 attacks a second).
Throw Axe (use; cooldown 30 s, 1% magicules): The axe spins out and bites.
Tensura engravings: crushing.
item.nusmp.lizardman_scouts_spear.desc: A long-reach spear of the lizardmen who scout the marshes, light enough to carry for a day and long enough to keep a wolf at arm's length. Use: Marsh Thrust.
item.nusmp.lizardman_scouts_spear.card:
Normal Grade spear (25.5 damage, 1.3 attacks a second).
Marsh Thrust (use; cooldown 30 s, 1% magicules): You lunge from far out of reach.
Tensura engravings: swift.
item.nusmp.hedge_wizards_oak_staff.desc: A knotted oak staff cut from a hedge by a mage who wanted to look the part. It does not do much, but a crack of magic does come out of the end when it is struck on the ground. Use: Hedge Spark.
item.nusmp.hedge_wizards_oak_staff.card:
Normal Grade staff (24.5 damage, 1.4 attacks a second).
Hedge Spark (use; cooldown 25 s, 1% magicules): A spark of green light jumps off the knot.
Tensura engravings: magic weapon.
item.nusmp.silvered_shortsword.desc: A shortsword coated with a thin layer of silver, the answer a careful adventurer has to things that bleed and do not stay dead. It cuts clean and it shines in the dark. Use: Silver Flash and Warding Cut.
item.nusmp.silvered_shortsword.card:
Special Grade shortsword (41 damage, 1.8 attacks a second).
Silver Flash (use; cooldown 30 s, 2% magicules): A bright arc of silver, and the dark gives up what it was hiding.
Warding Cut (sneak + use; cooldown 60 s, 2% magicules): You cross the blade before you and it holds.
Tensura engravings: holy weapon, swift.
item.nusmp.hakurou_school_practice_katan: A katana in a plain black sheath, given to the students of an old swordmaster who takes the swing of one clean cut more seriously than the number of cuts. It is balanced to a hair. Use: Iaido Cut and Calm Mind.

Special Grade katana (44 damage, 1.7 attacks a second).
Iaido Cut (use; cooldown 35 s, 2% magicules): You draw and cut in one movement.
Calm Mind (sneak + use; cooldown 70 s, 2% magicules): You breathe and settle your blade.
Tensura engravings: severance, swift.
item.nusmp.familia_smiths_mace.desc: A flanged iron mace from the forge of a smith's Familia, hammered by apprentices who were told it would be sold to somebody important. It breaks bones and keeps its shape. Use: Forge Bash and Anvil Guard.
item.nusmp.familia_smiths_mace.card:
